items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: He was on that tape with Frank Galbraith; he was one of the greatest.

ctx.x: Cab had a lot of trouble?
They had locked him in the Memphis office. Memphis used to be awful. It used to be awful. It's a wonderful country today, Frank, but it used to be (inaudible)
I wouldn't have wanted to play the south for anything in the world in those days.
